title: Panic Inbox
intro: Ten messages, each trying to scare you. One minute. Calm checking beats panic.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Your electricity will be cut tonight unless you pay $120 now: brightgrid-pay.live
cards.why: A threat to cut power tonight with a payment link. Check your own bill.

cards.text: Your SIM will be blocked in 2 hours. Update your details: vantel-sim-update.net
cards.why: A deadline and a look-alike link.

cards.text: Your bill for September is ready. See it in your Brightgrid account.
cards.why: It asks for nothing and sends you to your own account.

cards.text: Your account is frozen! Verify now: orrin-unfreeze.co
cards.why: A threat and a look-alike link. Open your own app.

cards.text: This is the Cyber Crime Branch. A warrant is out in your name. Stay on the line.
cards.why: A warrant over a call, with pressure to stay on the line.

cards.text: Payment of £212.00 at Gadgetz Direct was paused. If this was not you, open the Orrin app.
cards.why: It names the payment and sends you to your own app.

cards.text: FINAL NOTICE: pay now or face arrest.
cards.why: A threat of arrest by email.

cards.text: I have your photos. Pay $300 in the next hour or I send them to everyone.
cards.why: A threat with no proof and a short deadline.

cards.text: Reminder: your bill of £62.40 is due on the 28th. Pay in your app or online as usual.
cards.why: A calm reminder with a date, sent to your own account channels.

golden_rule: A message that scares you and hurries you is the one to check, slowly, on a number or site you already know.

quick_check.q: A message says your power will be cut tonight unless you pay by a link. What do you do?

options.text: Pay fast, it is dark soon
Check your own bill or app, and report the message
Call the number in the message

quick_check.explain: Fear and a deadline are the trap. Your own bill shows the truth.
